message.content:
A magazine cover for "TEMPO" dated "13-19 JULI 2020" features a complex isometric illustration of a vast beige maze. A large, dark green helicopter with spinning rotors flies above the labyrinth. A long rope ladder descends from the helicopter’s cabin door deep into the maze. A small figure in a black suit clings to the lower rungs of this ladder, leaning backwards. Several other small human figures are scattered throughout the maze's paths; some wave their arms, while one appears to be in a uniform.

Floating in the air near the man on the ladder are several green banknotes. The background is a dense, repeating pattern of beige walls forming the maze. Large, bold black text over the maze reads "SEKONGKOL JOKO TJANDRA". Below this, smaller black text states: "BURON KORUPSI HAK TAGIH BANK BALI ITU LELUASA MASUK-KELUAR INDONESIA. BETULKAH POLISI MENIKUNG KEJAKSAAN DALAM PENCABUTAN DAFTAR BURON INTERPOL?" At the top, white text reads "BERJIBAKU MENYELAMATKAN BANK MAYAPADA" and "ADU JURUS PARTAI MENJELANG PILKADA". A barcode and QR code are in the bottom corners.
